messages:
alice_support: escalation — customer (ACME Corp) reports US users are hitting EU edge and seeing +200ms latency. They send header `X-Client-Region: us,eu`. SDK v1.4.2 reported as sender.

ben_oncall: can you paste a minimal curl and the request id?

alice_support: curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_CUST' -H 'X-Client-Region: us,eu' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
Request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
Observed route: edge-eu-2 (p90 latency ~220ms). Expected edge-us-1 (~30ms).

carol_runtime: :eyes: checking routing logs for req_0a1b2c3d. Do we currently normalize multi-value region headers or treat as multiple header instances?

alice_support: gateway logs show header parsed as two values: ['us','eu']. Our fallback routing policy treats multi-value/ambiguous region as unknown and applies fallback that ends up routing to EU due to current capacity balancing rules.

ben_oncall: ouch. sounds like parser assumes a single token. Is this coming from SDK or client app? @dan_client any context?

dan_client: our JS SDK accepts config.preferredRegions = ['us','eu'] and sets header by joining with a comma. We assumed gateway supports CSV.

carol_runtime: short-term fixes: (1) hotpatch gateway to normalize multi-value `X-Client-Region` by taking the first token (quick mitigation), (2) update routing logic so multi-value headers are treated as an ordered preference list, not as unknown. Longer-term: update SDK to send a single canonical header instance (or structured JSON header) and add docs.

ben_oncall: mitigation plan: add nginx/lua rule at edge to split on comma and set `X-Client-Region` = first token for the US edge canary for 1h, then promote. I'll open INC-1234.

alice_support: I've asked customer to remove multiple preferred regions as a temporary workaround; they saw latency drop for some traffic after removing the CSV.

carol_runtime: also adding unit tests for multi-value header parsing and an integration test for ordered preference routing. Marking impact P1 due to customer-visible latency/regional misroute.

denise_eng: will file SDK PR to change join behavior and add config validation to warn when passing arrays.

incidents-bot: INC-1234 created by ben_oncall — title: "routing: multi-value client region header causes fallback to EU" | priority: P1 | blockers: gateway hotfix + SDK patch.

alice_support: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and attach logs.
